grammar.title: Would Like To — Convites
rules: "Would you like to...?" é usado para convites educados: Would you like to come to my party?
"I would like to..." expressa um desejo educado: I'd like to invite you.
Para recusar educadamente: "I'd love to, but..." — I'd love to, but I have plans.
